question: Can a separately authored standard-library-only implementation reproduce the finite GRPO audit-order characterization retained in v1?
selection_disclosure: This reproduction was selected after the v1 exact result and exploratory derivations were already known. It is a reproducibility check, not a confirmatory preregistration, novelty claim, empirical study, or external reproduction.

method.implementation: New standalone source; no imports from the existing VARE runner, auditor, or project package.
method.runtime: Python standard library only; no model, network, accelerator, or paid API.
method.enumeration: Enumerate all 16 four-bit action strings and all 16 four-bit reward strings for each action.
method.bit_order: Action/reward strings are big-endian for display; character index 0 is the leftmost bit and maps to coordinate 0.
method.score: For nonconstant binary rewards y with k=sum(y), population-standardized A_i=(y_i-k/4)/sqrt(k(4-k)/16); for constant groups set A_i=0. Compute G(a,y)=sum_i A_i*(a_i-1/4).
method.exact_arithmetic: Represent each value as r+s*sqrt(3) with rational r,s, using fractions.Fraction.
method.walsh: For every coordinate subset T, alpha_T(a)=1/16*sum_y G(a,y)*product_{i in T}(1-2*y_i).
method.pair_witness: For target action 0001 and T={0,1,2}, construct P±(y)=1/16*(1±(1/2)*chi_T(y)); enumerate exact marginal tables and means. Other action strata are identical across the two worlds.

acceptance_checks: all 16 action vectors are enumerated, with constant vectors having the zero update function
every degree-four Walsh coefficient is zero
each of the 14 nonconstant action vectors has a nonzero degree-three Walsh coefficient
P+ and P- are nonnegative and each sums exactly to one
every action-conditioned marginal table for subsets of size zero, one, and two is identical under P+ and P-
the selected order-three marginal has total variation distance 1/2
the action probability is 27/256 and the unconditional expected-update difference is -81/2048+27*sqrt(3)/1024
decision_rule: Any failed exact check is a reproduction non-pass; do not alter the definitions or acceptance checks after running the implementation.
limits: This result concerns one finite four-member binary-reward local score update only.
Same-host reproduction does not constitute independent outside-human replication.
No estimator sample complexity, practical audit budget, prevalence, model training, task success, or capability was measured.
The exercise does not resolve novelty relative to related verifier-auditing and GRPO work.
